<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: x-large;"><i style="color: #333333;">Make the Host and the Guest Exchange Roles</i></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
Initially, pretend to be a guest, but develop from inside to later
become the owner.</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
After conquering the State of Qin for the first time in 206 B.C., Liu
Bang (cf. stratagem 5) allowed his stronger ally Xiang Yu to take
over as its ruler. But while Xiang Yu relaxed, Liu Bang was building
up his forces, and in 202 B.C., he attacked and usurped Qin (in the
Battle of Gaixia). Xiang Yu, in shame, took his own life [18], [29].</span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Make
the Host and the Guest Exchange Roles</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 53rd hexagram, </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><i>Wind
over Mountain</i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">. The
effect of Wind's pliability over the firmness of the Mountain is
likened to a slow and gradual development toward cooperation and
adaptability </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">[1], [28]</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">.</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section82" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">

    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;信。</span></span></span></span></p>

	In China, if you want to change jobs, a formal letter of
	recommendation is needed.</span></p>

    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;下雨。</span></span></span></span></p>

	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">T</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">rans.: My Chinese is OK, but
	I still have an accent.</span></p>

	5) I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这件卫衣很暖和，但是不太舒服。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">因为你穿反了！</span></span></span></span></span></p>

	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">你说反了，应该是周二去海边，周</span></span>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	10)  Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这么晚了，你还这么清醒？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我刚要睡着的时候，一个很恐怖的</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;声音让我突然醒来。</span></span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她一直都很搞笑。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">12)</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: times;"> </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">作为客人，你应该尊敬主人。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他逼我看那部很吓人的电影。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	14) I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他是一名真正的艺术家，他很擅长</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;画画。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">II.
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">相反，我认为他不是。</span></span></span></span></span></p><br><br>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-29-deck-tree.html">Previous Chapter</a></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-31-beauty-trap.html">Next Chapter</a><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></p>
